name: Southern Cable Group Berhad
summary: Southern Cable Group Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cables and wires for power transmission and distribution, communications, and control & instrumentation applications in Malaysia and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Power Cables and Wires, Communications Cables and Wires, Control and Instrumentation Cables and Wires, and Related Products and Services. It also offers cables and wires for power distribution and transmission, communications, and control and instrumentation applications.
